name: Reading Time
description: Shows an estimated reading time, like "4 min read", under the first heading of every page, and keeps a per-page word count an editor can see in the site settings.

panels.title: Reading time
panels.description: The line shown under the first heading of every page on this site. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show a reading time
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: words-per-minute
fields.title: Words a minute
fields.description: How fast a reader is assumed to be. 200 is the usual figure for prose; 238 is the average adult.

fields.name: label
fields.title: Label
fields.description: The words after the number. "min read" by default.

fields.name: style
fields.title: Style
fields.description: A small pill with a clock, or plain text your theme styles itself.

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Accent colour
fields.description: Colour of the badge. Leave empty to use the text colour of the page.

fields.name: skip-pages
fields.title: Skip these pages
fields.description: Slugs separated by commas, for example: home, contact. These pages get no reading time.
